item.title: OXLADE-CHAMBERLAIN GO-AHEAD
item.description: ALEX OXLADE-CHAMBERLAIN is poised to end the guessing game and sign for Celtic today. The former Arsenal, Liverpool and England international midfielder has been a free agent since leaving Besiktas in late August. Martin O’Neill is determined to bring the 32-year-old 35 times-capped ace to Parkhead with a contract until the end of the season. [...]
